title: Yeti Summit Series Cactus Ice 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Yeti Summit Cactus Ice delivers a refreshingly unique vape, enhancing the subtly sweet and botanical flavour of Cactus fruit with a brisk wave of cooling menthol. Smooth and mellow in profile, this flavour offers a distinctive twist that’s both light and flavoursome, making it a superb choice for those seeking something a little different. Crafted with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers faster nicotine absorption with a more comfortable throat hit than traditional e-liquids, making it ideal for use with low-powered pod kits and MTL (mouth-to-lung) starter vape devices. The 50VG/50PG blend ensures a well-rounded vape, balancing smooth vapour with excellent flavour clarity for an endlessly satisfying experience. Yeti’s Summit Series offers a selection of double-concentrated nic salts, packed with that signature arctic freshness Yeti is known for. With three nicotine strengths to choose from, this 10ml nic salt range is a cost-effective alternative to disposable vapes.
